_readme: PLACEHOLDER VALUES. Run tools/discover_api.py against your own filtered antagning.se search URL first, then edit these fields to match what you actually observed -- see docs/API_DISCOVERY.md. Once filled in, copy this file to api_config.json (that's what src/scrape.py reads by default).

pagination._readme: style is one of: offset_limit | page_number | cursor. Only the params relevant to the chosen style are used.

response._readme: Dotted paths into each page's JSON body.

field_map._readme: normalized_column -> dotted path into each hit object. Adjust to match docs/api_example.json.
